instruction: Change the desktop clock to show 12-hour format instead of 24-hour.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.failure_analysis: Model created the profile correctly but could not set it as default. Used wrong command ('settings' instead of 'gsettings'), struggled with profile ID management, and ran out of turns (50).
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single gsettings change (clock format) within model's demonstrated ability to modify GNOME settings. No multi-step profile management required.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GNOME desktop clock format to 12-hour. Evaluator runs 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface clock-format' and checks output includes '12h'. Model can achieve this via Settings app or gsettings command.
